description: This PHP source file generates the 'At a Glance' page for a network gateway's web interface. It displays device status information such as battery charge, internet connectivity, Wi-Fi status, home network components, connected devices, and bridge mode controls. The file includes dynamic content generation, session management, and client-side scripting for user interactions.

methods.name: changeBridge
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to change the bridge mode setting and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: popUp
methods.description: Opens a new browser window with specified URL for additional configuration or information.
